manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0090; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: I read at night and I study at night are natural A1 time-of-day statements.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently preserves night as شب in the time context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the two target utterances and unrelated recent language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Short present-tense sentences fit early A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response changes the activity while preserving the time phrase.

overallCoherence.evidence: All lesson elements align on night as a time-of-day noun.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded time-of-day sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
